Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus, answered from Scripture.

Prayer for anyone whose brain holds mock trials at midnight.

He:: Jesus... I keep rehearsing arguments that never happen.
He:: In the shower, before every meeting, on the drive home. Full speeches to people who never said a word.
Jesus: You are litigating a fight I never asked you to attend.
He:: But if I don't prepare, they'll catch me off guard. I froze once and it cost me.
Jesus: I was in the room that day too. The answer isn't a better script; it's knowing you don't walk in alone.
Jesus: Bring Me the thoughts instead of rehearsing them. My comforts are made for the multitude.
